definitions.explanation: The feeling of emptiness, meaninglessness, or futility. The nominalized form of むなしい (empty, vain).

examples.japanese: むなしさ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
examples.english: I feel a sense of emptiness.

examples.japanese: ⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{報|むく}われない{時|とき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧むなしさ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧。
examples.english: The feeling of futility when your efforts aren't rewarded is overwhelming.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦{打|う}ち{込|こ}んで→打ち込む：04229_uchikomu⟧きた⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{辞|や}めた⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧、⟦{言|い}い→言う：00515_iu⟧よう⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧むなしさ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{襲|おそ}われた→襲う：01915_osou⟧。
examples.english: After quitting the job I had devoted myself to for years, I was overcome by an indescribable emptiness.

notes:
The noun form of the adjective むなしい (empty, futile, vain), formed with the suffix さ. Can also be written as {虚|むな}しさ or {空|むな}しさ in kanji, though hiragana is common. Expresses a deep emotional emptiness or the realization that something was meaningless.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- むなしさ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧: to feel emptiness
- むなしさ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{襲|おそ}われる→襲う：01915_osou⟧: to be overcome by emptiness
- むなしさ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{残|のこ}る→残る：01187_nokoru⟧: a feeling of emptiness remains
- むなしさ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{覚|おぼ}える→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧: to experience a feeling of futility
- ⟦{言|い}い→言う：00515_iu⟧よう⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧むなしさ: an indescribable emptiness

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{空虚|くうきょ}→空虚：15512_kuukyo⟧: void, emptiness — more literary and philosophical
- {寂|さび}しさ: loneliness — feeling of being alone, not necessarily futile
- ⟦{無力感|むりょくかん}→無力感：15659_muryokukan⟧: sense of powerlessness — focused on inability to act
- ⟦{虚無感|きょむかん}→虚無感：05997_kyomukan⟧: sense of nihilism — deeper philosophical emptiness
